dedupe_keys.name: liberacao para operacao comercial de empreendimentos de geracao

description: Liberação para operação comercial de empreendimentos de geração is a dataset listed in Brazilian electricity regulator open data portal (ANEEL), an open data portal, published or maintained by Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica. Este conjunto de dados reflete a listagem de capacidade instalada liberada para operação comercial. Estão disponíveis dois arquivos de dados: o unidades-geradoras-liberadas-operacao-comercial-detalhado(.csv,.xml), contém resumo de potência anual liberada para operação comercial a partir de 1997, em todo o Brasil, sem detalhes de Usinas e UF. Coverage: Brasil. The portal files it under the publisher Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica. Its tags are expansão da oferta, geração, operação comercial, unidades geradoras. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-repos-br-aneel.
